symptom: A pop-up's `actionbutton … (action: cancel changes)` left the pop-up open: the bare form stored ClosePage false. The skills' pop-up edit pages and most docs examples used the bare form; only `cancel changes close page` closed.
cause: The builder stored the `close page` suffix flag as ClosePage, so absence meant false — the opposite of Studio Pro, where every save and cancel button in ako/TestApp stores ClosePage true (31 of 31). Describe printed ClosePage false as the bare form, so the meaning was consistent but wrong for anyone writing MDL by hand.
fix: save/cancel changes default to ClosePage true; `with (ClosePage: false)` keeps the page open (the setting call workflow and complete task already had). Describe prints `close page` for true and `with (ClosePage: false)` for false, so both are explicit and an older mxcli reading either is never silently wrong.
insight: Count what Studio Pro stores before choosing a default: 31 of 31 settled it. A default flip needs describe to spell BOTH values explicitly, or a describe -> exec round trip through an older binary inverts the flag.
